items.name: spec_compliance
items.note: All trimmed ACs implemented (git backfill via Run-ID trailer only, provenance/coverage, schema v2); ADR/Area/FR trailers correctly NOT added, matching the architecture-review trim.

items.name: error_handling
items.note: _run_git never raises (catches TimeoutExpired/OSError, returns status strings); resolve_base_ref and build_run_id_commit_map soft-fail to None/no-repo rather than crashing build_index().

items.name: security_basics
items.note: No shell=True, argv-list subprocess only; base_ref is drawn from a fixed whitelist of ref names, never attacker-controlled; no secrets, no SQL/HTML surfaces in this change.

items.name: test_quality
items.note: All 23 new/changed tests assert on outcomes (sha values, file lists, provenance labels), not internal state; happy-path and unavailable/merge-excluded/no-repo error paths both covered per behavior.

items.name: performance_basics
items.note: Exactly two git subprocess calls per build_index() call regardless of event count (815 entries), not one per event; changed_files capped at 50 with a truncation flag.

items.name: naming_structure
items.note: shared/scripts/lib + shared/scripts/tests placement matches convention; largest touched file is 283 lines, all under the 300-line guideline; new test file split out proactively when test_event_context.py neared it.

items.name: affected_boundaries
items.note: Producer/consumer pairs listed in spec; round-trip Boundary Probe test (build_index -> JSON write -> load_or_rebuild_index cache-path read) passes and asserts provenance/coverage survive byte/dict-identical.

items.name: test_hygiene_probe
items.note: uv run shared/scripts/tools/scan_test_hygiene.py --diff reported no findings.
